title: Laser / toner — what your method wants
note: Toner is fused plastic sitting on the paper surface, so water-based Mod Podge goes over it without bleeding. Ask for colour laser, 100% scale, plain or lightweight paper. Cheap enough to reprint a sheet when a tile goes wrong.

shops.name: Post & Parcel
shops.note: Closest option to you. Small neighbourhood shop, good for last-minute jobs — call ahead to confirm colour laser.

shops.name: City Copy & Print Center
shops.note: Digital printing, fast turnaround, walk-in friendly. A short hop from Potrero Hill.

shops.name: Duxwell Printing
shops.note: Well-reviewed one-stop print shop; helpful if you want advice on paper weight for the transfer.

shops.name: AlphaGraphics SF Mission
shops.note: Full-service commercial shop. Reliable colour laser output, slightly more corporate pricing.

shops.name: FedEx Office
shops.note: Self-serve colour laser, open late. Upload the sheet ahead of time — but check 'Actual Size' in their print dialog.

shops.name: The UPS Store
shops.note: Counter-service colour laser and copies. Fine for a single sheet of four squares.

title: Fine-art inkjet — richer colour, but sacrifice a test tile
note: All three are pigment inkjet (giclée) studios. Colour depth beats toner noticeably on the Manet paintings. Pigment ink is far more water-fast than dye, but it is still inkjet under water-based glue — print one extra square, decoupage it onto a spare tile, and let it cure before committing the rest. Sealing the print with a light clear acrylic spray before gluing also helps a lot.

shops.name: Scale Up Art
shops.note: Artist-owned giclée and photo studio, the nearest fine-art lab to Potrero Hill. Giclée, metal, canvas, acrylic face-mounts.

shops.name: Dickerman Prints
shops.note: Museum-quality pigment prints on fine art paper or canvas. Walk-in workstations or order online.

shops.name: Hanson Digital
shops.note: Archival pigment printing and fine-art scanning since 2003. Worth it if you ever want large reproductions of these Manets.

title: Skip the craft — order finished coasters
note: If a tile goes wrong and you would rather not redo the glue-and-seal cycle, these take your exported square and ship back a finished cork-backed coaster. Upload the 4.0″ full-coverage export, not the 3.8″ bordered one.

shops.name: Mpix
shops.note: Waterproof hardboard with gloss finish and cork backing, ships in about 48 hours. Family-run lab with a strong reputation.

shops.name: Printful
shops.note: Square cork-back coasters, high-gloss, no minimum order — a single set is fine.

shops.name: Contrado
shops.note: Hardwood-based printed coasters, sharp HD reproduction. Good if you want a wood edge rather than cork.
